summary: The first lighthouse Canada built on British Columbia's wild west coast, lit in 1874; keeper's wife Minnie Paterson's 1906 trail run brought the rescue of the Coloma's crew.

access.note: Grounds open, tower closed; strenuous 7 km hike from Bamfield across a tidal beach.

events.note: Tramway of 633 ft built between landing beach and light
Tower rebuilt on old foundation, completed 17 October 1906
Minnie Paterson's trail trip leads to rescue of Coloma crew, 7 December
Diaphone fog alarm building erected, machinery being installed
Dry-rotted 1906 wooden tower replaced by steel skeleton tower
Two Airchime horns replace the diaphone

corrections.why: The record lists a standing steel tower built 1874; Lighthouse Friends says the first tower was a 31-ft white tower of 1874, rebuilt in wood in 1906, and replaced by a steel skeleton tower in 1958.

resolved_conflicts.explanation: 1874 is the first tower; the 1906 rebuild is documented by the Department report; the present steel tower dates from 1958 per Lighthouse Friends.

notes_for_editor: Pre-1900 history and keeper roster rest mainly on Lighthouse Friends (copyrighted; paraphrased) because the marine_ca corpus starts at 1900. Wikipedia dates the Coloma rescue to 6 December; consul's report (7 Dec) and Lighthouse Friends say 7 Dec; the Coloma left Everett 6 Dec. Cox start year conflicts within Lighthouse Friends (list 1878; narrative 'three years' after 1874). Tower heights differ: 13 m (heritage statement), 32 ft (LF), 10 m (record). Patterson 1895 date matched by column position in the OCR'd 1900 table; keeper roster gaps 1951-1963 not in source. Fiscal-year volume labels are corpus labels; I did not state fiscal years in prose. Check also that the heritage lighthouse record 14672 page text could not be fetched (placeholder). The 1906 Valencia date is given only as January 1906. Characteristic and range not verified from a source so omitted. Roster entries for post-1960 keepers are in public role only. Checker: USLHS 2025 article is an edited 2020 interview, so 'more than 15 years' dates from 2020 and 'staffed' is as of that interview; LF says Mickey Dolan followed Zacharuk. Patrol-man/wireless item is fiscal year ended 31 Mar 1924 (November 1923). Patterson 1895 appointment verified on page image (printed p.133).
